original.target_description: Experiment 1: paired current happiness during anticipation versus retrospection of Thanksgiving

n.quote: Participants were 36 university students (15 males, 21 females) who completed two questionnaires
n.exclusions: 16 additional anticipation-only participants not included in paired test; footnote 1.

replication.target_description: Thanksgiving within-subject current happiness during anticipation versus retrospection (DV1)

n.exclusions: General funneling removed two participants unable to mentally time travel and two unable to write about a scenario (p. 38). Main results explicitly described as pre-exclusion on p. 37; subsequent supplementary exclusions are not applied to these printed tests.

reported_success.quote: we did not find significant difference of the influence on current mood in Thanksgiving Day

notes: Extracted by neutral outcome description; supplied replication page locators interchange current emotion (DV1, p. 40) and predicted/remembered emotion (DV2, p. 41). No values converted. Replication main tables report pre-exclusion analyses, apart from general funneling.
